messages.subject: "number of observations"
parts:
Hi there,

I am using lavaan for conducting a cfa on a database of 140000 students (ICCS 2009 -http://www.iea.nl/iccs_2009.html).

However, after I run the analysis I get in the first line "number of observations = 75", what does this number mean? I would have expected here to read "140000" the total number of students, right?

Thanks for any suggestion.

Kind regards,
Michael.

messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: "number of observations"
parts:
Hi Michael,

My guess is that this is related to missing data. By default lavaan uses listwise deletion.If the number of observations used and total reported in the output differ, it is likely because of listwise deletion. To use other methods of missing data handling you can use the "missing = " argument to the cfa/sem/lavaan functions (for FIML) or the runMI function in semTools  (for multiple imputation).

Hope this helps,

Alex
